angles: Introduce Henry as a founder building anime and comics IP using AI, highlighting innovation in entertainment technology.
Discuss Henry's involvement with AI tools and agents, especially in relation to enhancing creator environments and storytelling.

openers: Hi Eric, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’m really interested in how AI can enhance accessibility in digital storytelling. What are your thoughts on that?
